messages:
Priya Rao: Hi team — small travel reimbursement question. Booked a private workshop room in Berlin last week and paid on my personal card. Vendor emailed an invoice to Redwood (I cc'd them) but the vendor total (EUR 450) doesn’t match my receipt (EUR 380). Vendor added a ‘service fee’ + VAT. What’s the preferred flow — reimburse me for the personal charge or should Finance pay the vendor directly?
Alex (Finance): Thanks Priya. Can you drop both the personal card receipt and the vendor invoice here? We need the vendor VAT invoice to pay vendor directly; otherwise we can reimburse you once we confirm the charge and policy. Also need cost center/chartstring.
Priya Rao: Uploading now — receipts bot should have them. The vendor invoice is addressed to "Redwood Inference GmbH" though I didn't provide company details when I booked. I attached my personal card statement line as well.
ReceiptsBot: Uploaded files: invoice_INV-2026-042.pdf, receipt_priya_berlin.jpg, cc_statement_priya_mar.pdf (links: https://files.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-042, https://files.redwood/receipts/receipt_priya_berlin.jpg)
Priya Rao: Pasted vendor invoice lines below for quick reference:
```
Invoice: Vendor Events GmbH
Invoice#: INV-2026-042
Date: 2026-03-18
Line 1: Meeting room rental (4 hrs) 380.00 EUR
Service fee: 40.00 EUR
VAT (5%): 30.00 EUR
Total: 450.00 EUR
```
Alex (Finance): OK — two things: 1) We need to confirm whether the service fee is a separately billable item under our travel policy (usually allowed if it’s a vendor fee for booking). 2) Because the invoice is addressed to Redwood Inference GmbH, we can pay vendor directly after verifying VAT ID and the supplier onboarding step. Priya, what's the cost center?
Priya Rao: Cost center is ENG-PLAT (project: platform-conferences). Also vendor emailed a PDF with no VAT ID in the footer — I highlighted that in the PDF.
Sahil (Legal): If the supplier invoice lacks VAT ID, Finance will likely ask for a corrected invoice before vendor payment. If timeframe is urgent, reimburse Priya for the exact personal card charge (380 EUR) and then we request corrected vendor invoice for the remaining items. Tagging Jordan for approval.
Jordan (Manager): I approve reimbursing Priya 380 EUR (room rental). For any service fee, please hold until vendor provides corrected VAT invoice or a justification.
Alex (Finance): Noted. Priya — I'll create a reimbursement expense in Expensify and route it to you for verification. Please confirm whether you want reimbursement in EUR or USD (bank conversion). Also confirm whether you want us to pursue vendor payment or you'd prefer we wait.
Priya Rao: EUR please. And please pursue vendor corrected invoice — the extra 70 EUR is legitimate (fee+VAT), would rather vendor get paid directly if possible. Thanks.
Alex (Finance): Great. Action items: 1) Finance to initiate reimbursement for 380.00 EUR to Priya (reimb ID: R-2026-331) — pending Priya confirm bank last 4 digits. 2) Finance to request corrected VAT invoice from Vendor Events GmbH and hold payment for 70.00 EUR until received. 3) Legal to confirm vendor onboarding VAT status. I'll update this thread when reimbursement is issued.
Priya Rao: Bank last 4 digits: 4321. Thanks everyone. :pray:
ReceiptsBot: Reimbursement R-2026-331 created and tagged ENG-PLAT. Estimated clearing: 3 business days.
Alex (Finance): Reimbursement issued — tx ref FIN-2026-7789. Closing the immediate reimbursement. Keeping vendor follow-up open.
Sahil (Legal): I'll reach out to vendor contact for corrected VAT invoice and cc Alex.
Priya Rao: Appreciate it — closing my side. :smile:
